doc: Captured code uses flags this runtime cannot treat as compile context.

All inputs that can change source compilation or descriptor output.

``path`` is the canonical path used to read and fingerprint the source;
``compile_filename`` preserves the exact lexical filename passed to
``compile`` because it is embedded in code descriptors as ``co_filename``.
One preparation per source, backed by the bounded private context store.

FIFO within three priority frontiers, with one task per definition.

Priorities are entry-reachable source candidates, orphan observed roots,
then the static remainder. A task may be promoted before it is processed;
later origins are retained even after construction has finished.
A view of an original admitted body; no records enter bare-ID maps.

Read the already published partitioned-call-operand-links v1 format.

Only manifest-local header/chunk carriers are opened. JSONL line locators
are explicit evidence locations, never canonical graph identity.

Navigate one explicit Run's conditional report into original graph ports.

Inputs are explicit, already produced snapshots. Hash checks establish
carrier correspondence, not that a forged report is a trustworthy runtime
producer. Original capture, source and routing conditions are not replayed
or removed. No current source is parsed or compiled by this reader.
An observed boundary, never a successfully established operand route.
Keep no event, local, argument, path or reference vectors.
Consumer for one event at a time; callbacks must not rely on later success.
Compatibility sink used by the full call-link reader.
A local evidence frontier; not a source mismatch.

Read an owned archive, or explicitly create/populate a fresh archive.

``create=True, compile_missing=True`` must be an explicit caller decision.
Construction itself does not read target source, compile, or load CodeType.
A read-only store never falls back to compilation. All materialized module
payloads remain immutable; the small writer manifest is atomically replaced.

Read-only archives admitted by explicit directory and manifest SHA tuples.

Construction opens only these explicitly supplied paths. ``store_for``
accepts a complete saved native CodeWitnessStore receipt; report-selected
URIs cannot cause a new archive to be opened. Module presence queries are
metadata only, distinct from resolve's complete nested descriptor check.
Top-level initialization facts for one locally indexed module.
A concrete tried context; equality can verify a guessed context's output.

One decoded snapshot and its cached, exact offline compile trials.

Shared by graph correspondence and automatic runtime-source inventory.
A compile result concerns code objects only, never effects or live binding.
An exact immutable-reference proof, privately created after a raw read.

Independent input, delta archive and small-report ceilings.

Parent artifact reads do not consume delta capacity. Source snapshots,
graphs and checkpoints/reports cannot borrow one another's capacity.
Global sidecar limits; source/raw limits additionally use CallEdgeBudget.

Verify v2 fragments through an explicit original CompositionIndex.

Cache compact verification results per file/body, not full graphs and not
per-marker computations. Locator URIs never become arbitrary open paths.

Resolve v3 definitions without extending the original inventory root.

Project bodies retain their original v2 witness checks. Dependency source
definitions resolve through the same public CompositionIndex resolver;
source-only evidence never creates a typed body or region activation.
The structured body rules with canonical environment and address ports.
Private projection of an actually decoded original row, not graph facts.
One construction, exact catalog and frozen producer policy.
Deterministically rederived import provenance and guarded suggestions.
Archive provenance of the exact original lowerer return, not an IR node.
Bounded lazy archive reader. No giant document is reconstructed.
Conditions that must remain visible to the consuming proof ledger.
Recomputable report; graph references are inputs, never stored authority.
Independent source-only profile; never substitutes bootstrap defaults.
Small JSON inputs only; reading never restores an owned model object.
Explicit immutable small root input; no decoder/provider callbacks.

Fixed catalog and owned scan; no arbitrary callback or verified=True API.

Streaming members are handed once to the publisher. Skipping/changing rows
or publishing before end-of-stream receipt verification is rejected.
Caller-scoped preconditions and observations, never accepted legality.
Strict, independently rederived primitive-rule descriptions.
Storage adapter only; canonical source/body records remain untouched.
An existing identity qualified by file and original body document.
An admitted original SP5 body, qualified without project fi/bi.
Bounded lazy queries over the original graphs, with no copied producers.

Small source projection consumed by call/source matching.

It deliberately has no SourceContextDigest: the call matcher does not
consume the three serialized semantic/control layer digests.
Shared resolver with demand-driven admission to one witness budget.
Body and correspondence, interpreted in its shared PreparedSource.

Private source snapshot, with no public graph getters or graph output.

Construction executes no target code or callbacks. Builders only read the
private source layers; emitted body records contain frozen IDs/references,
never mutable source definitions, graph registries or source AST objects.
This is local construction validation, not public source replay authority.
Bounded access to original work, invocation and source references.
Closed set of conditional semantic predicates understood by this ledger.
An explicit, scoped Q condition.  It remains DECLARED in every proof.
Behavioral contract and declared preconditions for one analysis scope.
A proposed earlier result and the invocation whose work is removed.
A typed rule request bound to the concrete Optimization TransformDelta.

Caller-owned models required for independent proof recomputation.

``verification_budget`` is the verifier's resource ceiling.  It is not
serialized in a ledger and cannot be raised by a document being checked.
Explicit scoped logical producer witness; never an observation hint.

doc: EEG endpoint with a closed ID union for the strict record codec.

Queries validate their inputs afresh; mutable graphs have no validation cache.

Registry bindings use the consumer's typed invocation wire as binding scope.
Registry event ordinals are never compared to CPU/GPU timestamp clocks.
Deserialized records require ``validate_result`` before reuse with this graph.
Attach evidence to the same prepared snapshots used for source lowering.
An explicitly missing original snapshot, distinct from contradictory bytes.

Bounded reader/resolver over one existing dependency continuation.

Construction validates small manifests, source snapshots and provider
evidence. Source graphs are decoded lazily, once for each file's code
definitions. Public graph queries receive defensive copies of owned views.
A view of original records; membership does not materialize a body.

Regular partitioned source accessor, never a ProgramInventory impersonator.

Constructor reads compact references and signatures, not canonical graphs.
``bind_scan`` must check a fresh current raw scan before any provenance or
canonical body can be used. Source invocation JSONL rows are not consumed:
dynamic observations are independently rebuilt from raw frames, and their
manifests/groups/counts are compared to the verified source report.
One parent field and optional list index on a statement-to-expression path.
A source expression's structural path to its containing CFG statement.
A bounded lookup of expression source to statement-level CFG context.

Private copies for one ordinary, callback-free reader interval.

No public owner is put into fast mode. The existing normal guards bracket
the whole session and every user callback; only copies unreachable by that
callback reuse checked input receipts and PreparedSource. Returned entry
queries are rebound to their still-checked original catalog, not restored
lowering owners or JSON proof tokens.

Explicit source owners and immutable archives; no fi/bi for dependencies.

Catalog rows are metadata candidates. resolve() performs original graph
membership validation before exposing an existing qualified definition.
Actual source-bound query/check session, not a serialized authority.
Independent publication/binding profile; seed ceilings grant no raw I/O.
Live worker provenance; JSON is never accepted as its constructor input.
Use the original builder's buffers/budget, with a different Region owner.
Keep coordinates and interval facts; reference vectors remain in raw rows.
Use exact retained names and bytes, then the shared coordinate API.
Read decoded source once per witness snapshot; never parse or compile it.
One source import protocol and attempted store, then exact opaque suffix.
One actual mapping frame; existing expression/loop rules, no fast locals.
Construction-only references to this canonical completion, never a fact store.
Public checksum-bound reader; no raw session or ownership factory.

Already checked body fields used by CompositionIndex, without file layers.

This private in-memory projection is never serialized as SourceProgram or
treated as validation input. Original source contexts remain in their exact
archived artifacts. Projection occurs only after ordinary admission checks.
A dynamic operation and the evidence inherited from its descendants.
A report-only top-down placement hypothesis for one candidate.
Control-tree and state summaries reconstructed from a ProgramGraph.
A ValueVersionID scoped to the exact artifact that defines it.
An ObjectID scoped to the exact artifact that defines it.
A declared native input position at one actual initial block visit.
A declared native output position at one actual Return/Raise occurrence.
Per-query exact snapshot resolver shared by MatRef and region queries.
Forward a validation context while adapting only issue/gap reporting.
The original source/native public endpoint, re-exported there.
Original ETO collector-scope containment, never identity or direct call.
Existing static member; no dynamic occurrence or activity is implied.

Replay raw receipt slots once; resolve individual canonical lifetime rows.

``birth_verified`` / ``free_verified`` mean exact receipt correspondence,
with ``free_verified`` additionally requiring an unambiguous slot replay.
They remain conditional on the explicit provider and ordering contract.
``ordering_qualified`` requires a declared pinned revision and an explicitly
disabled provider timestamp adjustment.  None is never treated as False.
The caller must separately map EvidencePoint.process to the declared pid.
This pinned adapter's ordered ABI disagrees with the original core.

Owned typed result; builtin_type names its normalized literal representation.

No static literal, original Python class or pre-conversion origin is proved.

Immutable source-owned port resolver, sealed to one exact native window.

Default profiles grant reference/port correspondence only. The explicit
scalar input capability grants exact local primitive content/observed roots,
without upstream producers, hidden effects, alias completeness or readiness.
Immutable source bytes for one bounded fragment, never restored by JSON.
Fixed selector profile for a byte-prefix write declaration.
P traversal charged immediately to the caller's one derived budget.

fields.name: argument
fields.type: UseID | CompletionResult | BodyDriveResult | ResumeInput | SavedInput | None

doc: One resource lifetime, distinct from its changing state and observations.

A manifest chunk reference plus actual JSONL line and line-local pointer.

The chunk locator addresses ordinary manifest JSON. Line/ordinal address
the referenced JSONL provider; they are never a fictional JSON array.
Resolution requires an explicit bound provider reader, never URI opening.
A supplied external snapshot violates its explicit catalog contract.

Exact detached external graphs, cached only within one query/resolver.

A fresh resolver rechecks mutable caller catalogs on first access. Cached
graphs are detached from callers and correspond to the bytes checked on
that access. This verifies declarations, never runtime/provider facts.
Snapshot serialization/validation cost is separate from geometry budgets.
No artifact URI is opened and no caller-specified decoder is executed.
One live canonical static proof; no native or execution qualification.
Collect one lexical scope, without leaking nested scope bindings.

Multi-view graph for an arbitrary program.

Nodes are intentionally not forced into one exclusive taxonomy: a call
can have CONTROL, ACTION and RESOURCE edges at once. The graph can be
populated statically from source and enriched with dynamic Event nodes.
Formal ports and actual read slots are deliberately separate.

Whether this overlay has a concrete compatibility fact for a binding.

The current physical-handle model can reject known Python bool slots, but
it cannot positively prove general slot/materialization compatibility.
One ordinal event clock shared by every call in this overlay.
Typed entry/exit window for one concrete operation instance.
An explicit role/slot/handle observation for one invocation.
Fresh registry guard result, evaluated at current_event, never cached.
Recomputed structure, slot coverage and current-guard findings.
Indexes rebuilt for each check against the mutable external models.
Deterministic overlay; raw records only, never cached validation status.

Builtin type/content; never an identity or execution proof.

Integer payloads are bounded canonical decimal; floats use 16 lowercase
hexadecimal IEEE-754 bits; complex values use real then imaginary binary64
bits; bytes use lowercase hex. ``from_python`` defaults to the historical
literal subset; pass ``exact=True`` for complex and lossless surrogate
codepoint payloads.
Information established by one local binding definition.

Define the state of one LocalBindingValue.

``value`` must be an operation result. Block arguments are merges and get
their state from the actual incoming CFG edges, so they have no row here.
UNKNOWN means an imprecise update whose possible values are not asserted;
``previous`` and the producing operation's incomplete world access keep the
uncertainty connected to the prior binding and effect state.

Connect a local-binding input to a read's possible normal result.

A missing result is valid only when validation proves the binding
definitely UNBOUND and the operation terminates by raising. A present
result may be a dormant NORMAL completion value of an INVOKE whose
binding is definitely UNBOUND; derived feasibility says that completion
cannot occur, so the value is not an ordinary successful read.
The entry module's source scope; this is not a lowered function body.
Group outcomes; the enclosing inventory stores the seed report once.
Declare a use of an existing state location, without another world.
A lexical interface with fixed, explicitly unproved frame conditions.
Name entry's pending operand and the saved-context canonical result.
Restore context and forward pending through an existing CFG edge.
Retain separate saved/new pending Uses and the context restoration Use.
Declare an abstract primitive's reference result, not a Python lookup.
A next-hop case forwarding core Uses without projecting the payload.

Select the next cleanup obligation; final dispatch remains a C0 action.

Case coverage, actual operand ownership, current-state forwarding and the
next Enter/Replace/dispatch destination are graph obligations. A shared
destination block is representable; it is not a proof of a legal route.
Derived indexes only, valid for this immutable graph representation.

Declared lexical owner with nonempty, directly owned block identities.

Scope nesting, graph ownership and source correspondence need graph checks
or separate evidence. Declaring CLEANUP does not authorize execution.
A declared completion destination, never an inferred live transfer.

Exception and traceback references for this particular propagation.

A traceback operand may refer to legitimate None. It is not asserted equal
to exception.__traceback__ at every later point. Mutable exception attributes,
active handler context and current state are not captured by this record.
Already evaluated control payload; its referenced target stays mutable.
Project the existing pending payload on a matching dispatch successor.

Declared dispatch over pending ports, with current-state operands separate.

Destination compatibility and operand ownership/availability are graph
obligations. Reusing a target block is representable; these records neither
authorize cleanup nor store a second table of dynamic actuals.
One physical file's dotted name under one candidate search root.
A possible module path; namespace candidates point to directories.
Index of a NORMAL signature result on the owning INVOKE record.

One canonical entry reference and its declared state dependency domains.

Locations need not be disjoint across members: several members may depend
on the same coarse world.  A captured cell reference denotes the cell's
identity, not an immutable capture of its contents.  Missing defaults are
represented by an ordinary reference to None, not by omitting the member.
``cell_slot`` is this body's free-variable interface slot (``co_freevars``),
not the enclosing function's origin binding or a runtime cell identity.
An own formal promoted to ``co_cellvars`` is not a captured environment slot.

A complete ordered declaration of a function's environment entry ports.

Distinct reference ValueIDs identify distinct ports, not distinct Python
objects: actual argument references and captured cell identities may alias.
The builtins member denotes the function's saved builtins namespace, which
need not equal the current globals['__builtins__'] value.  Code definition is
a static declaration; this record does not verify a runtime function binding.

Explicit Python formals alongside an existing environment declaration.

Parameters retain declared signature order, independently of the physical
entry block's port order.  Region/code ownership comes from the referenced
environment; actual arguments remain on canonical call/invoke operations.
Graph validation checks entry reference types and the complete, disjoint
partition of formals, environment references and state parameters.  Source
signature coverage is a separate provenance/replay obligation.
This SCAR invocation's work; not a replay identity or target measurement.

Fixed rule semantics, explicitly separate from its unproved condition.

There is deliberately no writable authority/termination/free boolean.
The rule is completion-preserving *if applicable and completed*; UNKNOWN
applicability and effects cannot be promoted by decoding a report.
Interfaces with no standalone ast.Call; actual target/effects unverified.
Enables lifecycle declarations for one existing driver interface region.
Names one body drive and one actual source successor operation.
Declares the first publication operation for one drive source.
Declares a body-only terminal mark on a created-close true edge.

A conditional post on an operation's after-state or NORMAL completion.

Request/body are distinct owned Use ports; their actual values may alias.
Current-state support and source applicability are checked separately.

Immutable must facts for current Reference carriers at one program point.

Different alias classes mean unknown equality, not proved disequality.
Sources are possible seed operation witnesses, not licenses or producers.
Before/after operation facts and each renamed edge before target meet.
Fact points at a code/const-pool record; index selects its co_consts slot.
Abstract immutable Data content only; never a Python object identity.
The type of a local-name binding token, distinct from object values.
SSA token for whether one Python local slot is bound and to what.
SSA protocol payload, distinct from Python references and state contents.
Content declaration on an original producer, never an object identity.

Canonical control terminator.

For ``BRANCH``, ``successors[0]`` is the true edge and
``successors[1]`` is the false edge. This meaning is part of the core IR
contract and does not change the ordered wire representation.

fields.name: terminator
fields.type: Terminator | PendingDispatchTerminator | CleanupRouteTerminator | SuspendTerminator | BodyDriveTerminator | None

doc: A whole-source child interface, not an assertion its internals ran.
Ordered original module.body suffix plus its original CFG boundary.

SP7 indices over original facts/core, with no stored-content proof.

IMPORT_NAME owns level/fromlist until its opcode completion; STORE_NAME
consumes its stack input on both completions. Neither rule establishes
physical reclamation. Namespace addresses describe protocol attempts only.
Exact source collection; anchors never invent coverage for old CFG gaps.

Source indices over core29's sole FrameRoot entry authority.

B's raw exception-reference boundary is not C0's exception packet and
supplies no traceback/pending/handled-context proof. Later capabilities
may connect those existing core relations without another body wire.

A declared flat signature over canonical ports, not artifact replay.

Slot order is native signature order, independent of core physical order.
Region ownership and the native/core-only complete disjoint partition need
graph validation. State and mutation-role semantics are not inferred here.
An always-unproved obligation; evidence supplies context, not discharge.
Partial/many-to-many declared correspondence, never equivalence authority.
One validated-core index, original flow and shared query budget.
The complete natural key of one existing ProtocolOperation.
Expected projection from an original raw pack, never a callee operand.
Expected source for one original BODY_INGRESS resume slot.

An original READ checks whether B has an active protocol session.

This is independent of frame activity and the checking request's phase.
It stores neither a holder, a truth value nor a mutable occupancy fact.
Independent raw and whole-packet anchors, not a normalization proof.
An exact contract-result foreign key or owned-result contradiction.
One immutable-model query context with shared indexes/cache/budget.
An owned edge-forward Use is not an actual call operand.
One exact UseID owned by an operation, even when its Value is aliased.
Only the owner and READ sites actually consumed by the predicate.
The real reference operand; neither a body nor a raw pack is added.
Original bool production and intended branch, without a phase state.
A provider-scoped coverage declaration, never a legality certificate.
Missing evidence denotes a named gap, not zero cost or no effects.
One provenance mapping; actual dependency endpoints stay in the core.
A bound-callable projection of an existing callee Use, not a new SSA value.
New receiver-aware relation version; old SourceCallPortModel stays v1.
A landing parameter's declared saved source or later ingress slot.
A source operation's exported outcome operands, without saved/private slots.
An existing formal and its canonical source Use, without a new producer.
A declared instance-frame projection, without choosing a Create occurrence.
A body formal's canonical source or instance capture recipe.
An original access, canonical before Use and actual write result (if any).
Declared source/owner/state links; no runtime or lifecycle proof is granted.
Original predicate inputs and its actual bool-conditioned branch edges.
An explicit true-path finish, without a body outcome or new producer.
Original explicit declarations; their runtime applicability stays unknown.
Positioned conditional facts, not native/runtime or free/ready proof.
A conditional exact-edge source; not an observed body entry or permit.
A declaration and its envelope, not equivalence or occurrence proof.
Derived existing call Uses, not a second canonical binding store.
A requirement bound; it is not a measurement of available capacity.

A relation within one owner's operation occurrence/region activation.

Cross-owner occurrence pairing needs an explicit future interface. Static
IDs from independent calls must not be treated as shared runtime bindings.
Typed ownership; content/order versions remain canonical graph values.
One temporal ingress; saved sources are resolved at its Suspend.
Export this drive's payload/state and name possible later ingress edges.
One caller operand's conditional correspondence to a body parameter.
A caller completion value corresponding to a candidate exit port.
The producer's original graph namespace, not a new graph or node ID.

One original JSON record with physical and decoded identities.

``declaration`` points to the original manifest's artifact declaration.
The pointer applies to decoded JSON; the artifact SHA applies to stored
bytes, including gzip when present. No constructor performs I/O.

An original definition in its root, artifact and source namespace.

Root/provider records are evidence references. Ownership metadata does
not prove effects, package-at-capture identity or a canonical typed body.
``graph.pointer`` names the original semantic definition record.
The original MODULE declaration; a module need not have a SourceAtom.
Static code/source-body category, independent of the entering protocol.

Exact entry ports; different ValueIDs never prove different objects.

Cells retain their declared positional port order. Source/compiler and
activation evidence must separately check their meaning and actuals.
Reference the existing environment/formal partition, without copying it.
One entry authority for one FRAME scope, not a dynamic frame instance.
The existing state domain, with no extra owner identity.
Three-valued proof state; missing evidence is always ``UNKNOWN``.

One auditable claim required by a candidate transformation.

``evidence`` names the provenance class (for example ``Observed`` or
``Inferred``), while ``status`` states whether that evidence proves the
claim.  Inferred syntax can therefore support a useful hypothesis while
the claim itself remains unknown.

Required contracts for this source abstraction, never accepted facts.

These exclude hidden preexisting namespace objects/finalizers and mutation
by signals, threads, callbacks or frame tracing between modeled operations.
Later legality checking must discharge the applicable contracts; graph
construction and a constant derivation do not discharge any of them.
Potential invalidation; retaining a candidate is never proof it survived.
Wire fields from OIR schema 1; new payloads cannot masquerade as v1.
Exact transform-delta fields before static substitutions were added.
Plan alternative with the strict schema-2 delta shape.
The decoded source snapshot used by semantic and control overlays.
A versioned source span; line number alone is never an identity.
Provenance for one fact, without upgrading it to a proof.
One auditable proof obligation and its evidence.
Explicit extension namespace for facts outside the stable core schema.
Append-only mapping claims; ambiguity is represented, never overwritten.

One scoped provider-map token, without object or content semantics.

Repeated tokens do not establish Python identity, content equality,
storage/allocation identity or a lifetime. Evidence retains the provider's
actual interpretation and the original input/output slot location.
Normalized execution records; no optimization selection is performed.
A semantic version independent of object identity and storage.
Explicit wrapper so the Python value ``None`` is a valid literal.
A source-level rewrite; optional binding names the binding being rewritten.
Complete source statement membership, independently replayed by its reader.
Static value facts needed to join an OIR proposal to its source model.
The value, definition and span selected by a static binding.
Validated report-only replacement regions and alternatives.
A validated view over separate SG, EEG, ValueGraph and optional OIR.
Static definitions and typed relations, without runtime claims.

A strided view: offset and strides count dtype elements, not bytes.

Zero strides represent broadcast views.  Negative strides are allowed for
CPU/NumPy views when the complete addressed interval fits the allocation.

A scoped object identity observation, independent of its contents.

Registration does not declare a birth, release, allocation or logical
value version. Evidence identifies the observation that supplied the ID;
first and last observations are not object lifetime boundaries.

A validated v2 value/provenance graph.

This graph deliberately contains no optimization decision.  It answers
which logical versions, provenance records and physical representations
were declared or observed.
All decisions plus the candidate indices selected for application.
One per-process monitor attached to an existing CallEdgeRecorder.
Independent sidecar attached by an existing exact-function CALL hook.
Explicit enrollment exceeds the retained snapshot byte budget.
The requested tensor or synchronization policy is unsupported.

Enroll once, compare on demand, release explicitly.

``max_bytes`` bounds retained CPU payloads. Temporary work is chunked; it
includes bounded index buffers for strided inputs and a CPU byte staging
buffer, rather than a full per-comparison clone. Prefix equality only
triggers full comparison. CUDA is disabled unless ``allow_cuda=True``;
that opt-in includes device synchronization and all transfer time in cost.
Byte limits describe tensor payloads, excluding allocator bookkeeping and
cached device memory. Unsupported minimum working sets are rejected.
One delayed capture. close() is idempotent and never stops a foreign ETO.
Original source lacks a required witness; not an identity contradiction.
Bounded incremental JSON tokens; no full ETO document is assembled.
Live writer-owned, authenticated private navigation; no load constructor.
Same external binding checks as execution validation, without fake code.

Local decode result, not an IR record or an evidence capability.

builtin_type names the normalized PythonLiteral representation, never the
class of an original Python object before provider conversion.

One bounded accounting ledger; complete legacy passes are explicit.

The unchanged public coordinate binder reports verified complete artifacts.
Its full-pass read multiplicities are charged separately and labeled derived;
newly opened adapter streams count returned bytes directly. Reservations are
charged before a phase, reconciled after success, and never reusable credit.
Fresh immutable raw join preimages, never a canonical graph or old owner.
Own per-module inferred contracts and expose auditable counters.
Small fixed table sink using SCAR's existing bounded chunk writer.
Bounded new-provider reader plus a fixed same-ID handle selection view.
Explicit schema2 FD-only view over public R2; no table-context authority.
Selection is qualified, but no independent resource coidentity proof exists.
One immutable selection over R2; registries are explicitly selected/partial.

Explicit original base plus bounded public selector resolver.

This first adapter binds the original publication path. A moved copy does
not silently acquire the old URI from a hash; relocation needs a separate
future receipt adapter. Selector URIs are never opened.
Fixed immutable base/refinement selection; never a complete model.

Read-only provider callback view; not a new IR or FD qualification.

binding is supplied only by the existing private-table replay at entry.
Shared/unknown tables and resumed calls never receive a guessed binding.

Read only PUBLISHED schema2 transport, checking full chunks before yield.

Byte/ordinal verification does not validate Linux effects, canonical links,
or all cross-record references. Callers can decode selected typed records
through the existing public record_codec independently.

One owned provider process, with bounded nonblocking reads.

Only new provider rows enter a sample; an old GPU observation is never
silently relabeled with a fresh sampler timestamp. Missing providers do
not trigger repeated spawn attempts.
Sample resources for one traced process until :meth:`stop` is called.
Companion transport only; it never changes the legacy event stream.

Descriptor capture and explicit exact checkpoints, with no backend.

Caller must exclude concurrent writes during capture/verification. Shared
NumPy/ctypes aliases remain open unless a write or exact comparison is
observed. Sparse, quantized, meta, conjugate and negative-bit tensor
representations are explicitly unsupported by this first adapter.
